_source_note: New class built (Sept 2026) from 65 real Ascension screenshots (Cultist.docx, exact levels/numbers/costs) plus the big CoA handoff doc for structure, spec identity, and passive filler (same two-source pattern as Runemaster). 4 specs confirmed: Godblade (Strength melee DPS, Enhancement Shaman/Ret Paladin analog), Corruption (Intellect ranged DPS, Shadow Priest analog), Dreadnought (Strength tank, Blood DK analog), Heretic (Intellect healer, Discipline Priest analog - damage-that-heals loop). Mana + Insanity dual-resource confirmed via screenshots (Blade of the Empire generates, Wrath of the Black Empire/Entropic Slam/Hammer of Twilight spend, Sanity Tap converts Insanity->Mana). 5 mutually-exclusive Presences (C'Thun/Y'Shaarj/N'Zoth/Yogg-Saron/Horrifying) and 4 mutually-exclusive Whispers (C'Thun/Y'shaarj/N'Zoth/Yogg-Saron) confirmed, each with a base + Greater (raid) version like Stormbringer's Call of the Wind/Storm.

abilities.name: Dreadnought
abilities.description: Absorb damage, scaling with Intellect and Stamina, and protect your movement speed from falling too low.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 20, 'Absorbs 395 damage, scaling with Intellect and Stamina. Protects movement speed from going below 80% of normal speed. Lasts 20 sec. Depletes all Insanity upon expiration.'  ABSORBED NOTHING. Its description promises absorption and it carried no absorb at all. The engine has supported them the whole time - StatusEffect.absorb soaks the RAW incoming amount before armour, resistance, avoidance and every percentage reduction - and 22 other abilities already use absorb_pct_max_health, a FRACTION of the recipient's max health, banded 0.06-0.40. Simplification note: real CoA Entropic Strike has a weapon-damage component alongside its Shadow-tagged Seething Void effect - this engine models it as pure Shadow school for now (matching the named Void effect, since there's no mechanism yet for a single ability to deal a physical hit AND apply a separately-schooled debuff in one action). abilities.name: Tentacle of N'Zoth
abilities.description: Summon a ground Tentacle of N'Zoth that silences and repeatedly damages the target, re-targeting if they flee range.
abilities._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Ground summon: silences + repeats damage on target; re-targets if target flees range.' Real numbers not confirmed via a dedicated screenshot; pet summon stubbed as a direct debuff.  Removed dead flag stat_mod(s) ['silenced']: nothing in the engine reads them. The real mechanism is the ability-level is_stun flag, which this ability already carries. Keeping them was the is_aoe trap waiting to happen: data that looks like the mechanism and is not. This engine has exactly one incapacitate mechanic, is_stun, with no separate silence or root category (see StatusEffect.is_stun).
